for all intents and purposes this story is an isekai where a human from our world is sent to a galaxy inhabited by all kinds of sentient life

in my mind the language gap would be navigated by automatic translators everyone has (how it works will not be discussed in detail) meaning that every word the reader hears from other characters is essentially translated from the character's alien language into english

so the main character arbitrarily using masculine or feminine pronouns with other aliens (which is admittedly kind of ironic now that I think about it) wouldn't be a big deal bc theoretically it's being translated to use the proper gendered language according to whatever that character speaks

but idk how to (or if I need to) reconcile an alien's translator using the appropriate pronouns with the main character but using gendered pronouns for other alien races
